reviews.title: Better than 3090ti Suprim in media server
reviews.comment: I baught it to replace my 3090 ti suprim in my media server and the A5000 did NOT disappointed me. It was better than 3090 in multi monitor output management and its mosaic was very smooth and good and very easy to setup.
reviews.author: Youssef A.

reviews.title: Do NOT buy from SaveCentral. They are NOT and authorized reseller of PNY Pro GPUs
reviews.comment: Do NOT buy from SaveCentral. They do NOT support the products that they sell. I purchased a $2K NVIDIA PNY A5000 GPU for AI/ML projects. It died after 13 months of VERY light usage (warranty is 3 years). Since SaveCentral is NOT an authorized reseller of PNY GPUs, I am now the owner of a $2K brick, while I have a important project that is now completely dead in the water. SaveCentral offers ZERO warranty help because they are NOT an authorized reseller. Do NOT use this company if you need to use any product over a couple of dollars that is insignificant to your needs.
reviews.author: Jeff TX

reviews.title: Great Condition
reviews.comment: The physical condition of the card is basically new. Even the fans were clean. Performance is great, similar to a 3080 but with much more head-room with all the VRAM.
